character.description: Cute soft pastel SD researcher: glasses optional as face accessory, cardigan, notebook gesture without prop bake Fixed top-down / slight 2.5D, thin dark outline, flat shading.

style: match Office V2 Visual Contract: cute 2D, soft pastel, clean outline, no photorealism, no isometric drift

idle.action: front view; subtle breathing and one blink; feet planted; BODY ONLY

walk-down.action: front-view walk toward camera; clear gait; BODY ONLY

walk-up.action: back-view walk away; clear gait; BODY ONLY

walk-left.action: side-view walk left; clear gait; BODY ONLY

walk-right.action: side-view walk right; clear gait; BODY ONLY

work.action: CRITICAL: BODY ONLY typing pose — arms and head move as if at a keyboard. Do NOT draw desk, laptop, monitor, chair, mug, or any furniture.

sit.action: CRITICAL: BODY ONLY seated pose with feet/legs tucked. Do NOT draw chair, sofa, or cushions.

talk.action: CRITICAL: BODY ONLY standing talk gesture; one hand moves. Do NOT draw other characters or furniture.
